location.pixel_convention: zero-based native cutout after reversing disk y, consistent with Mastergrid

flags: Fitted phase change is small relative to scatter; wavelet speed/direction is poorly constrained.
checks: PASS: automatic wavelength/direction search; positive/negative 80 m/s waves; nonuniform timestamps; phase sign and units
method: Automatic local wavelet power peak in the saved slow spatial template over wavelengths and 0..175-degree axes; lock that wave filter and seven fixed points across frames; unwrap relative complex phase; linear fit versus actual Epoch seconds. This differs from the previous PNG/cosine-amplitude workflow.
limitations: Observation-minus-fast retains temporal variability but depends on the layer-splitting estimate and includes its fitting frames. Not independent validation or a pure-airglow retrieval. A short interval and weak phase change can limit speed accuracy. Template-control speed largely reflects imposed translation. Speeds are signed normal-to-wave phase speeds, not necessarily a full flow velocity.
